correctness.rationale: The two-update Laplacian equation L(f+g)=0 on connected loopless K_n forces complementary binary firing vectors in every nontrivial two-cycle. For a cut S of size a, exact iff threshold intervals are [n-1,n-1+(n-a)-1] for firing vertices and [n-1-a,n-2] for nonfiring vertices, giving independent lengths n-a and a. Summing labelled cuts and dividing by two proves the claimed all-mass polynomial; reciprocal exponents sum to n(2n-3) giving exact mean n²-3n/2. The entropy exponent h(u)=(1-2u)log(u/(1-u)) has sole maximum 0 at 1/2 and expansion -8(u-1/2)², so lattice Laplace gives N_n~n^n/4 and variance n/16 for cut size. Given a, the n chip counts are independent uniforms, common mass mean n²-3n/2 and total variance n[a(n-a)-1]/12; bounded increments relative to n^{3/2} justify the uniform conditional Lindeberg CLT and independent joint Gaussian. Checked the actual verify_cut_cycle.py and separately computed cut-population exact counts and conditional moments for n=2..13. These finite checks do not prove the limit.
